headlines.title: Oil Market Tightens as Tanker Attacks and Inventory Draws Mount
headlines.summary: Brent crude is once again over $106, Iran is intensifying attacks on tankers in Hormuz, and global inventories are draining, while OPEC just forecast stronger demand for next year. Six months ago, one well-timed TruthSocial post by President Trump would have calmed traders down.
